sourceNotes: 支持上下行流量统计与增量连接记录，配合 XStats 1.5.0 查看最近 15 分钟历史和应用流量趋势，不读取通信内容
保留旧版主程序的连接查看与组件管理接口，主程序和组件可分别升级
分离采集预算与界面窗口，按需采集并在停止时保存尾批，过载时明确提示数据不完整

en: Add upload and download counters and incremental connection records; use XStats 1.5.0 for 15-minute history and per-app traffic trends without inspecting communication content
Preserve connection viewing and component management for older XStats clients so either product can be upgraded first
Separate capture budgets from the display window, collect on demand, drain recorded events on stop and explicitly report incomplete data under overload
